notes:
### 新增

### 修复

- 修复在线、离线阅读器进退时上一级下载页或详情页的位移：上一页不再参与 Android 阅读器缩放，并在系统栏切换期间保持原有安全区和滚动位置（#63 补充）。
- 修复离线阅读器进入阶段的卡顿与额外画面位移：保留原有缩放转场，统一全屏布局并提前校验首图，避免纵向模式同时加载过多图片（#63）。
- 已完成的离线缓存条目隐藏下载进度条，未完成任务继续显示进度（#62）。

### 变更

- 详情页“下载已开始”提示右侧增加“跳转下载页”入口，提示与入口保持同一行显示（#66）。
- 侧栏弹出与收起动画调整为 2 倍速，保留手指拖动跟随、遮罩及返回键行为。
- 下载页面点击可阅读资源的卡片即可进入离线阅读，移除独立阅读按钮，删除按钮置于卡片右下角；列表和卡片视图在收藏红心左侧显示当前 EH/EX 来源的已缓存图标（#64）。
- “最新”页面支持从内容区向右滑动打开侧边栏，保留标签切换及纵向滚动手势（#65）。
- Android 正式版应用显示名称由 oviewer 调整为 OViewer。
- Android 普通 Debug 版使用独立包名和名称 OViewer Debug，可与正式版同时安装，应用数据各自独立。

### 已知限制

summary.classification_reason: Hide the download progress bar and its spacing once an offline task has completed.
summary.subject: fix(download): hide progress for completed offline books

summary.classification_reason: Give ordinary debug builds a separate application ID and label so they can coexist with release installations, and optionally export the debug APK for device validation.
summary.subject: fix(android): isolate ordinary debug app from release

summary.classification_reason: Remove the additional ordinary Debug APK workflow input and artifact while retaining the independent local debug application ID.
summary.subject: fix(ci): restore original Android build artifacts

summary.classification_reason: Display OViewer as the Android release application name while preserving package identity, signing, debug labels and build artifacts.
summary.subject: fix(android): capitalize release app display name

summary.classification_reason: Make offline cards directly readable with compact delete controls, show live source-aware cache indicators in gallery tiles, and open the drawer on a right swipe from Latest without interfering with tab navigation.
summary.subject: fix(ui): improve offline cards and latest drawer swipe

summary.classification_reason: Run the drawer settling animation at twice the normal speed using a local Material drawer controller while preserving drag tracking, focus, navigation and other animations.
summary.subject: fix(ui): double drawer transition speed

summary.classification_reason: Add a localized downloads-page action to the successful gallery download snackbar.
summary.subject: fix(download): link start confirmation to downloads page

summary.classification_reason: Keep the download-start message and downloads-page action inline instead of using the default action overflow row.
summary.subject: fix(download): keep snackbar action on the same row

summary.classification_reason: Preserve reader zoom transitions while stabilizing fullscreen entry, move verified local reads off the UI isolate, overlap first-page preparation, and prevent vertical loading placeholders from eagerly decoding whole books.
summary.subject: fix(reader): stabilize offline entry and prioritize first image

summary.classification_reason: Complete regression coverage for offline source selection, cancellation during history writes, and viewport readiness across window changes without changing application behavior.
summary.subject: test(reader): cover source selection and entry window changes

summary.classification_reason: Stop Android reader transitions from animating the preceding page and preserve its system-bar insets until actual restoration, retaining page state and scroll position for both online and offline reading.
summary.subject: fix(reader): keep parent page stable during reader navigation

summary.classification_reason: Correct the Material 3 download card assertion that blocks Android and iOS candidate builds; validate with the CI Flutter SDK.
